scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:all: pnpm dev:infra && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && sleep 2 && pnpm db:migrate
